name: dynamodb
description: Reads, changes, and writes Amazon DynamoDB tables through the AWS JSON API with connector-local SigV4 signing, typed operation schemas, bounded reads, DynamoDB Streams changefeed support, and reverse-ETL write gates.

risk.read: bounded SigV4-signed DynamoDB and DynamoDB Streams JSON-RPC reads against configured table, resource, or stream identifiers
risk.write: typed SigV4-signed DynamoDB mutations/admin actions declared in writes.json; destructive actions require confirmation
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, approval token, and destructive confirmation where declared

conformance.reason: Tier-3 native package (internal/connectors/native/dynamodb): DynamoDB uses AWS JSON-RPC X-Amz-Target dispatch plus SigV4 signing and typed AttributeValue envelopes. The declarative replay engine cannot execute these native operations; connector-local native tests and sanitized fixtures cover the operation registry, request bodies, pagination, writes, direct reads, and CDC helpers.
